reason: Receipts are my bookkeeper's job and I don't want to send my company's spending to a Telegram bot from some small outfit I've never heard of. The missing documents are a real headache, but if the guys never post the receipt in the chat, a bot reading the chat won't find it either.
objection: Will this little bot still be running in a year, or will I move all my records into it, get my bookkeeper used to it, and then it disappears and I'm back where I started with my financial data sitting who knows where.
would_change_my_mind: My bookkeeper telling me she already uses it with other clients and it actually cuts down what's missing at month end.
